rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance annual allowable increase (3/1/2026–2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, landlords may raise rent by no more than 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Multiply base rent by .016 to get the maximum dollar increase.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the 3/1/2026–2/28/2027 allowable-increase period announced January 14, 2026.

unverifiable_exemptions: Exemptions under the Rent Ordinance not described in this document

rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rent-controlled units under the SF Rent Ordinance; document does not detail coverage.

parsed.doc_summary: SF Rent Board announcement (Jan 14, 2026) that the annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units from 3/1/2026 to 2/28/2027 is 1.6% (prior year 1.4%).
